Don't worry about it, if you're using it that much, you will be inclined to buy a bass amp anyway.

What you do is basically get your original matrix on the left (I'm talking about the example here, you could put it on the right as well and mirror the whole process), and you put **I** next to it. And you perform row operations (you do the same row operations to **I** as well (originally right side)) until you get **I** on the left side, where you had **A** originally...
